mode: Actual Docker RAG image with Tesseract vie+eng and mounted current source/tests read-only; network disabled; Qdrant in-memory and fixture embeddings
command: docker run --rm --network none --mount type=bind,source=<repo>/backend/rag-worker/tests,target=/app/tests,readonly --mount type=bind,source=<repo>/backend/rag-worker/app,target=/app/app,readonly --entrypoint python wh-notebook-rag-worker -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py -v
